data.title: A volunteer day at the Dolná Mariková-Široká small fort
data.excerpt: On 7 March 2015 the Hradiská civic association spent a day clearing the acropolis of the small fort at Dolná Mariková, a site of the Baden culture, the Púchov culture and the Slavs. The volunteers removed the scrub that had blocked both the views and movement across the site, and took steps to document illegal activity there.
data.metaDescription: On 7 March 2015 volunteers of the Hradiská civic association cleared the overgrown acropolis of the small fort at Dolná Mariková-Široká and opened up its views.

children.text: On 7 March 2015 our civic association Hradiská held a volunteer day – clearing the acropolis of the small fort of the Baden culture, the Púchov culture and the Slavs at Dolná Mariková (the locality known as Široká – Šimunky). A large part of our association took part, as well as other volunteers. We rid the small fort of a great quantity of self-seeded scrub, which had made not only the view but also movement across the site practically impossible. The weather granted us a pleasant day and the whole day of work passed in a relaxed spirit thanks to the good mood. Excellent goulash was not missing either. We cleared almost the entire acropolis of bushes, thorns and self-seeded trees. Only now can you fully enjoy the beautiful views and the atmosphere of this wonderful place. Finally, to protect the small fort from looters, we took steps to document illegal activity.
In this video you have the chance to see what state the acropolis was in before our volunteer day.
